categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the research, development, and sales of analog chips, with a core emphasis on battery management chips. Its product portfolio extends to various power management chips including battery safety chips, battery metering chips, and charging management chips. These products serve diverse applications such as laptops, tablets, smart wearables (e.g., TWS earphones), power tools, mobile power supplies, light electric vehicles, cordless appliances, smartphones, drones, AR/VR devices, and PD mobile power products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced analog integrated circuit design technologies, including multi-channel high-voltage acquisition and comparison, high-voltage switching, system-level ESD protection, battery characteristic analysis and modeling, and high-precision battery metering algorithms. It follows a fabless business model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors. The company emphasizes low power consumption, high precision, high safety, and high stability in its chip designs, supported by proprietary algorithms like 'FastCali' for battery state estimation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international brands in consumer electronics and industrial sectors such as Dell, HP, Lenovo, Samsung, Xiaomi, Honor, Stanley Black & Decker, TTI, and others. The end markets served encompass consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, wearables), industrial control, new energy vehicles, energy storage, and IoT devices. The company targets both industrial-grade and consumer-grade applications, with a growing focus on high-end and differentiated products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main operations located in Dongguan, Guangdong Province. It has subsidiaries and branches in Shanghai and Shenzhen. Approximately 80% of its revenue is generated from domestic sales, with about 19% from overseas markets. The company also maintains international customer relationships and exports products globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Operating as a fabless semiconductor design company, the company is positioned midstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It focuses on chip design and sales while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to upstream foundries and subcontractors. This model allows flexibility in product iteration and shortens development cycles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment, focusing on high-precision, low-power, miniaturized, and intelligent analog chips. It aims to expand product lines and upgrade existing products to meet diverse market demands, including emerging sectors like new energy storage and electric vehicles. The company also emphasizes talent development, intellectual property accumulation, and strengthening core technologies such as battery characteristic modeling and advanced power management circuits.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of analog integrated circuits, including battery management chips and power management chips. The company sells mainly via a distribution (resale) model, with a smaller portion through direct sales. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control to customers, typically at product delivery and acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Texas Instruments (TI) and Analog Devices (ADI) in the battery management chip segment. It is recognized as one of the main domestic suppliers with competitive product performance and strong market presence in China. The company differentiates itself through focused R&D, flexible customer responsiveness, and stable supply capabilities, positioning it as a key player in the domestic analog chip market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 393 million, representing a 57.64% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 78.8 million, up 31.9%. R&D expenses accounted for 29.07% of revenue, reflecting a 42.02% increase in R&D investment. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and R&D intensity, supported by expanding market demand and product portfolio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, high safety, high stability, and ultra-low power consumption in its chip products, addressing critical battery management challenges such as state monitoring, charge estimation, and safety protection. Its proprietary technologies and algorithms enable superior accuracy and reliability, meeting stringent customer requirements. The company also offers comprehensive solutions tailored to diverse applications, backed by strong technical support and a robust service system, fostering high customer loyalty and brand recognition.
